observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor parking lot or street setting and in front of graffiti wall backdrop
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, appearing both solo and in small groups
observation.formation_and_space: informal grouping, dancers facing the camera individually or in pairs
observation.posture: upright torso with flexible knees, shifting weight dynamically
observation.footwork: fast stepping and weight shifts coordinated with the beat; exact foot placement cannot be seen clearly due to wide shots and cuts
observation.arms_and_hands: arms swing, point, gesture actively, and hold body parts or clothing
observation.hips_and_torso: frequent hip movement, bouncing, and torso isolations
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level drops, squats, and occasional turns
observation.costume_and_props: casual street wear including jackets, hoodies, tank tops, shorts, jeans, caps, and sunglasses
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and precise weight distribution are obscured by rapid camera cuts and low-resolution lighting in dark scenes

signature_moments.what: bouncing step with arms swinging across the body near cars
torso bounce and hip movement in front of graffiti wall
crouching and dipping down in night lighting with vehicle headlights
stepping and pointing gestures facing camera outdoors
rapid bouncing and knee bending in dark setting with lights
